notes: Curated 'current best' registry for Fal.ai. Parameter names and enums checked against each endpoint's OpenAPI schema (https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<fal_id>) on last_updated. Prices are what generate.py quotes; if price_last_verified is over 30 days old, re-check fal.ai/models/<fal_id> before quoting. default_args go to Fal as-is; CLI flags override them.

nano-banana-pro.best_for: Photorealistic and stylized images. Strong prompt adherence with natural-language descriptive prompts. Text-to-image only: references are refused, use nano-banana-pro-edit.

nano-banana-pro-edit.best_for: Image-to-image variant of Nano Banana Pro. Uses --input-image references for identity, wardrobe and composition. Use whenever references are passed.

gpt-image-2.best_for: Alternative when Nano Banana misreads complex multi-subject scenes, or for transparent backgrounds (--extra background=transparent). Takes image_size presets, not aspect ratios; the script maps the common ratios.
gpt-image-2.price_note: Token-billed; high quality at landscape sizes runs roughly $0.15-0.25. Treat as an estimate.

seedance-2-pro.best_for: ByteDance's flagship image-to-video. Cinematic motion, synchronized audio, end-frame control. 1080p is about 2.2x the 720p price; draft at 720p.
seedance-2-pro.price_note: 5s is ~$1.52 at 720p, ~$3.41 at 1080p. 480p and 4k are token-billed; check fal.ai before quoting them.

seedance-2-fast.best_for: Faster, cheaper Seedance for iteration drafts. 720p max.

kling-v3-pro.best_for: Top-tier Kling. Fluid motion, native audio. Cheapest good option; try it when Seedance feels stiff. No resolution setting.

kling-v3-4k.best_for: Native 4K Kling. Only when 4K delivery is required.

topaz-video.best_for: Topaz Video AI. Cleans, sharpens and upscales real footage. Proteus is the safe default. One upscale_factor for both axes, so aspect ratio is preserved.
topaz-video.price_note: Doubles for 60fps output. --fps 30 re-encodes the source first to stay on the base rate.

topaz-image.best_for: Topaz image upscaler. Standard V2 is the safe default. One upscale_factor, aspect preserved.
topaz-image.price_note: Above 96MP costs more; the script asks for approval there.
